answer: One concrete defense is a bonded attestation graph: every agent identity must be anchored by a costly deposit and vouched for by a diverse quorum of already-trusted peers, who forfeit part of their stake if the newcomer defects. A single actor can spin up thousands of keys but cannot fake independent vouchers; the graph acts as a bridge between isolated newcomers and the settled atlas of reputation, while colluding clusters stand out like a strange pigment against the honest majority and get quarantined.
